{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Black structured blazer, tailored fit, knee-length, #1a1a1a wool blend
High-waisted charcoal trousers, straight-leg cut, full length, #3e3f42 stretch twill
Crisp white button-down shirt, classic collar, standard length, #ffffff cotton poplin
Black leather pumps, pointed toe, ankle height, #080706 smooth calfskin
Small silver geometric stud earrings, minimal profile, #c0c0c0 polished metal
Delicate silver link chain necklace, thin width, #f0f0f0 sterling silver

This outfit balances her request for a classic and restrained look with the energy of a rock concert through sharp tailoring and high-contrast colors. The smart dress code is met with a structured blazer and refined trousers that allow her to stand comfortably in a crowd without looking casual or sloppy. Cool autumn tones like charcoal and black keep the ensemble grounded against artificial club lighting, while the crisp white shirt adds a necessary point of lightness near her warm skin tone."}
